statements.text: President Trump announced a reciprocal energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. President Zelenskyy assured the Prime Minister that Ukraine would implement it immediately once a start date is confirmed.
The UK has announced a new sanctions package covering over 90% of Russia's oil producing capacity.
The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.
The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 Lightweight Multirole Missiles to Ukraine over the next four years.
The Prime Minister and Chancellor Merz agreed a new partnership to tackle hybrid threats in Berlin.

The Prime Minister confirmed in his speech to the United Nations General Assembly the commitment to establish a National Centre for Information Defence. The Foreign Affairs Select Committee recommended the Centre.
The UK-EU summit will take place in Brussels on 20 November.
The Prime Minister confirmed in New York that AI will be centre stage in the UK's G20 presidency.
The site of the Great British Railways headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026. It will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.
Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.
Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.
76,000 extra seats a week have been introduced across the network.
A £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north is set to be built at Alstom's Derby site.
The Scottish Government has announced a long-term programme for local government reform.
